hypothesis: UTC Saturday-Sunday range reversion in BTC and ETH perpetuals can cover execution and funding costs when inventory is statically bounded and the weekend is force-closed.
nullHypothesis: Net return after base cost, or after the stress cost schedule, is not positive.

data.historicalReusePolicy: 2026-06-18_and_later_is_development_only; only post-boundary complete weekends count as evidence

rule.anchor: first complete 5m close at Saturday 00:00 UTC
rule.sessionExit: flatten at the first bar at or after Monday 00:00 UTC

leverageScenarios.tenX: not_evaluated; rejected as a design candidate because the observed weekend tail is too large

costs.funding: realized point-in-time funding rows charged on signed notional at each funding timestamp

evaluation.selection: none; the rule is frozen and no parameter may be changed after the boundary
evaluation.passGate: test net_return > 0, test stress_net_return > 0, base max_drawdown < 20%, and no unmodeled liquidation
evaluation.failureAction: research_only; do not tune, paper trade, or promote
